acceptanceCriteria: The failure is reproduced (for example -race -count=200 under load) with its text and run id retained, or the ticket is closed as not reproduced with the command and counts retained.
If reproduced, the root cause is fixed with a deterministic regression test.
body: Suspected, not confirmed. During the 2026-10-10 CI-balance work a TestCALV0197_* test in internal/tasks/store/program_role_stage_test.go (TestCALV0197_RunRoleSelectsAnsweredWaitOfItsStage, RoleSelectsByStage, NewQuestionClearsResumedAnswer) was flagged as a suspected flake. The run id and exact failure text were not retained, so this needs reproduction before any fix. Possibly related to the process-wide programWriter lock or the stage-slot race (V1-0825). Fold into the V1-0849 reliability umbrella if reproduced.
title: Suspected flake: TestCALV0197 store program-role tests
